rules.requirement: Reject an unsupported source version instead of guessing its interpretation.
test_plans: Bootstrap golden with an unsupported preamble asserts deterministic rejection and no legacy fallback.

rules.requirement: Reject unsupported generated-lock or built-ins versions instead of partially reading them.
test_plans: Strict-reader table tests cover unsupported lock and built-ins versions and assert that no partial IR is returned.

rules.requirement: Do not select a source, lock, and built-ins tuple other than 1/1/1 for source version 1.
test_plans: Version-registry contract test asserts the sole source-version-1 tuple is lock 1 and built-ins 1.

rules.requirement: Compilation does not read environment variables, clock, hostname, PATH, installed programs, network, or random state.
test_plans: Poison-provider property tests vary every prohibited ambient input and require byte-identical IR, diagnostics, and lock output.

rules.requirement: Enumerate compiler inputs deterministically and fully validate exported IR without hiding errors.
test_plans: Order-randomization and eager-versus-lazy differential tests require identical complete diagnostics and sealed IR.

rules.requirement: Require the exact ASCII source-version preamble as the first non-comment profiles entry.
test_plans: Raw-byte bootstrap fixtures cover the exact preamble plus binding, interpolation, soft-break, comma, duplicate, and wrong-file negatives.

rules.requirement: When templates exist, vars.enc.yaml is a tracked regular file.
test_plans: Repository fixtures cover missing, untracked, symlink, special-file, and tracked-regular vault inputs with and without template leaves.

rules.requirement: An ambiguous unqualified query fails and lists accepted qualified spellings.
test_plans: CLI goldens create cross-namespace ambiguity and assert failure plus a byte-sorted complete qualified-name list.

rules.requirement: Source input is strict UTF-8.
test_plans: Exact-byte lexer fixtures and arbitrary-byte fuzzing reject every malformed UTF-8 class with tight byte ranges.

rules.requirement: IDENT does not equal dot or dot-dot.
test_plans: Contextual-identifier fixtures accept neighboring dot-containing names and reject exactly dot and dot-dot.

rules.requirement: At, dollar, and question sigils are adjacent to their subjects.
test_plans: Sigil-adjacency matrix fixtures cover each sigil with zero, horizontal, and newline separation in every valid context.

rules.requirement: Unicode escapes denote scalar values and exclude surrogates and values above U+10FFFF.
test_plans: Escape boundary goldens cover zero, maximum scalar, both surrogate edges, above-maximum values, digit counts, and hex case.

rules.requirement: Decoded source paths are nonempty safe relative paths with valid components and no leading or trailing slash.
test_plans: Bare and quoted PATHREF tables test every forbidden component, separator, control, interpolation, and valid punctuation neighbor.

rules.requirement: Path-typed strings resolve only to symbolic-home or absolute POSIX paths.
test_plans: Path-schema fixtures cover tilde root, tilde descendants, absolute paths, and relative or alternate-anchor negatives.

rules.requirement: Path-typed strings exclude alternate home syntax, backslashes, controls, invalid components, trailing slash, leading double slash, and root as a leaf.
test_plans: A table-driven negative fixture isolates every forbidden destination spelling and verifies its exact schema diagnostic.

rules.requirement: Source and destination path strings are NFC.
test_plans: Canonical-equivalence fixtures accept NFC and reject decomposed spellings without silently rewriting them.

rules.requirement: Adjacent atoms in input sugar have at least one horizontal whitespace byte between their spans.
test_plans: Parser fixtures compare spaced, tabbed, concatenated, commented, and newline-separated string-atom forms.

rules.requirement: Every resource block has exactly one direct bare key attribute.
test_plans: Resource-schema fixtures cover missing, duplicate, nested, string, interpolated, and valid direct bare keys.

rules.requirement: An extension target is declared by a normal demand or resource block elsewhere in the repository.
test_plans: Repository fixtures resolve forward and cross-file extension targets and reject extension-only identities with related spans.

rules.requirement: A deployable authored path node component-prefix-matches at least one selected payload leaf.
test_plans: Deployment fixtures cover exact, ancestor, textual-prefix-only, excluded, variant-selected, and empty implicit mappings.

rules.requirement: A cycle diagnostic shows the entire active cycle and every contributing span.
test_plans: Graph goldens cover self-cycles, multi-node SCCs, duplicate edges, profile-inactive cycles, full paths, and all related spans.

rules.requirement: Same-group fact contributions are structurally equal.
test_plans: Fact-merge fixtures compare equal scalar/list contributions and conflicting contributions while asserting every origin is reported.

rules.requirement: Descriptions decode to exactly one line.
test_plans: Schema fixtures cover ordinary descriptions and escaped CR, LF, and control values in every description-bearing context.

rules.requirement: The shared group is declared.
test_plans: Profile fixtures reject a missing shared declaration and assert the registered identity diagnostic.

rules.requirement: The shared group has a directory.
test_plans: Profile fixtures reject abstract shared and accept directory-bearing shared with the expected active order.

rules.requirement: The shared group is a declared root group.
test_plans: Nested-shared and duplicate-shared fixtures reject non-root placement while preserving all declaration spans.

rules.requirement: Each profile declares exactly one default manager.
test_plans: Per-profile manager fixtures cover missing, duplicate, unsupported, and each registered manager without group inheritance.

rules.requirement: Each profile declares one scalar OS equal to darwin or linux.
test_plans: Profile schema and resolution fixtures cover missing, list, duplicate, unknown, Darwin, and Linux OS values.

rules.requirement: Every active group's declared OS equals the profile OS.
test_plans: Profile projection fixtures exercise matching, conflicting, inactive, and inherited group OS constraints.

rules.requirement: The bound machine OS and normalized architecture belong to the selected profile's final intersection.
test_plans: Bind matrix tests cover every OS/architecture pair, accepted aliases, rejected aliases, and empty or incompatible intersections.

rules.requirement: Every declared group directory exists as an ordinary directory.
test_plans: No-follow repository fixtures cover present directories, absent paths, regular files, and special objects.

rules.requirement: A declared group directory is not a symlink.
test_plans: Group-discovery fixtures reject directory symlinks regardless of whether their targets remain inside the repository.

rules.requirement: Declared group directories are unique.
test_plans: Directory-map fixtures reject exact duplicate normalized paths and report both group declarations.

rules.requirement: Declared group directories do not equal or contain one another.
test_plans: Component-prefix fixtures cover parent-child overlap, reverse order, textual non-component prefixes, and normalized equality.

rules.requirement: An applying command refuses saved-profile and matched-host disagreement unless the invocation explicitly selects a profile.
test_plans: Bind/apply integration tests cover agreement, disagreement refusal, explicit override, read-only reporting, and saved-state update behavior.

rules.requirement: Every tracked theme-profile basename is an IDENT.
test_plans: Theme inventory fixtures cover valid names, reserved words, Unicode, spaces, nested files, duplicate identities, and nonordinary objects.

rules.requirement: A command check basename matches the registered safe command-name expression.
test_plans: Adapter-shape fixtures cover all boundary characters, slash, dot names, whitespace, empty names, and valid authored/default basenames.

rules.requirement: A logical package directory basename is representable as IDENT.
test_plans: Facet-discovery fixtures cover valid digit-leading basenames and invalid Unicode, reserved, separator, dot, and dot-dot names.

rules.requirement: Discovery does not consult private, global, environmental, or untracked Git ignore sources.
test_plans: Poison Git-provider tests vary info/exclude, global config, environment, and untracked ignores while requiring invariant inventory or the specified untracked-ignore error.

rules.requirement: CI rejects a committed lock whose declared source is absent from a clean checkout.
test_plans: Clean-checkout integration tests compare authoring with untracked payload against CI verification after that payload is removed.

rules.requirement: Every tracked worktree object exists.
test_plans: Index/worktree matrix fixtures reject tracked-but-missing regular files and symlinks with exact source paths.

rules.requirement: A tracked worktree object's no-follow type agrees with its index mode.
test_plans: Index/worktree differential fixtures cover regular-to-symlink and symlink-to-regular swaps plus allowed execute-bit drift.

rules.requirement: Every selected repository path is strict UTF-8 NFC with slash separators and safe components.
test_plans: Raw Git-path fixtures cover byte-only paths, decomposed Unicode, controls, separators, empty components, dot components, and valid NFC paths.

rules.requirement: A source symlink target is relative UTF-8, lexically safe and in-repository, resolves to an existing object, and crosses no escaping or broken symlink.
test_plans: Symlink fixtures cover every listed target condition independently, chains, directory targets, raw-target preservation, and valid in-repository links.

rules.section: 17.3 Plain, encrypted, and template source names
rules.requirement: A private-sensitivity facet contains only recognized transformed leaves.
test_plans: Transform fixtures combine private facets with plain, SOPS, template, excluded, executable, and mixed descendant leaves.

rules.requirement: A user-copy facet has explicit mappings covering every payload leaf.
test_plans: Coverage fixtures exercise facet-wide, path-prefix, partial, excluded, transformed, and zero-leaf user-copy plans.

rules.requirement: Every system-privileged payload leaf is covered by an explicit mapping.
test_plans: System coverage fixtures assert that no implicit destination is synthesized and that every winning leaf has explicit provenance.

rules.requirement: A variant name is neither base nor none.
test_plans: Variant discovery fixtures reject both reserved names and accept neighboring valid identifiers.

rules.requirement: Every variant package contains a package.dotfile file.
test_plans: Variant inventory fixtures cover missing, empty, regular, symlink, and wrong-type metadata files.

rules.requirement: Read-only status warns when an active group with variants has no selection.
test_plans: Status CLI goldens cover missing selections with and without a clearly non-applicable base-only preview.

rules.requirement: A destination-mutating command refuses until every active variant-bearing group has an explicit variant or none selection.
test_plans: Bind/apply tests cover complete, partial, unknown, inactive, explicit-none, invocation, and saved variant selection sets with zero mutation on refusal.

rules.requirement: Binding rechecks destination collision equivalence against the actual destination volume.
test_plans: Modeled and real-filesystem tests cover exact, case-folded, and Unicode-equivalent collisions on case-sensitive and insensitive volumes.

rules.requirement: System descendants sharing a synthesized parent agree on numeric owner and owner-group.
test_plans: Directory-prerequisite planner fixtures combine agreeing and conflicting UID/GID descendants and assert whole-plan refusal.

rules.requirement: An existing destination parent is a real non-symlink directory traversable by the intended identity.
test_plans: No-follow prerequisite tests cover ordinary, symlink, file, inaccessible, swapped, and correctly traversable existing parents.

rules.requirement: Every mutating deployment consumer performs all nine specified locking, recompilation, binding, identity, validation, planning, approval, execution, and journaling preconditions.
test_plans: A shared preflight state-machine suite injects failure before and after every numbered precondition and proves no earlier failure permits mutation.

rules.requirement: Guarded replace and prune are single linearizable namespace operations satisfying the exact token and mismatch contract.
test_plans: M0 capability-spike models token changes and adversarial races; later disposable-VM tests prove one-operation success or fail-closed refusal per filesystem.

rules.requirement: Replacement or pruning of a ledger-owned object uses the guarded-operation contract.
test_plans: Capability-matrix and fault tests assert guarded calls on supported targets and explicit backup/adopt refusal on unsupported targets, never racy fallback.

rules.requirement: Secrets and rendered private data never enter any forbidden output or state channel.
test_plans: Secret-canary integration and crash/fault tests scan lock, argv, environment, names, logs, diffs, diagnostics, ledger, hover, links, and artifacts.

rules.requirement: Stable IDs do not use delimiter-only concatenation or locale-sensitive sorting.
test_plans: Independent digest vectors include delimiter-collision candidates, Unicode paths, locale changes, and exact U64BE boundary encodings.

rules.requirement: A read-only semantic query using a stale lock displays that state.
test_plans: Human and JSON CLI goldens query a stale lock and assert an explicit stable stale-state field without changing output semantics.

rules.requirement: Every destination-applying command independently recompiles and byte-compares canonical lock output.
test_plans: Tamper and stale-lock integration tests cover edited rows, retained header hashes, source drift, canonical mismatch, and zero mutation before comparison succeeds.

rules.requirement: Diagnostics do not mint an unregistered string code without revising the owning version.
test_plans: Registry completeness test rejects emitted codes absent from the frozen stage/version inventory while allowing registered structured details.

rules.requirement: Recipient values pass the registered age public-recipient syntax.
test_plans: Recipient-schema fixtures include every supported public prefix, checksum/length corruptions, private identities, whitespace, and duplicate labels.

rules.requirement: A benchmark run ID's final component equals its epoch key.
test_plans: Benchmark-schema fixtures cover matching and mismatched epochs, malformed timestamps, hex case, duplicates, and canonical ordering.

rules.requirement: All mandatory theme base, map, and profile files are tracked ordinary files rather than symlinks.
test_plans: Theme-discovery repository fixtures vary absence, tracking, type, symlink status, basename, nesting, and profile cardinality for every mandatory file.

rules.requirement: A font family string does not contain a comma.
test_plans: Font-schema fixtures cover leading, middle, trailing, full-width, escaped, empty, and ordinary family strings.

rules.requirement: Every effective palette reference resolves.
test_plans: Theme-resolution fixtures cover base, override, map, selected and unselected profile references with full related-origin diagnostics.

rules.requirement: A KDE role name does not shadow a palette name.
test_plans: Theme identity fixtures cover exact cross-map shadowing, case-distinct names, profile-introduced names, and unrelated role namespaces.

rules.requirement: Resolved themes contain general and nerd fonts plus all three required size fields.
test_plans: Base/profile merge fixtures remove each required field in turn and verify inherited, overridden, missing, and wrong-type outcomes.

rules.requirement: Every Eza category role key names a category declared by the Eza application map.
test_plans: Eza join fixtures cover assigned, map-only, missing, duplicate, reordered, and profile-overridden category identities.

rules.requirement: One theme-file scope does not declare the same decoded Eza pattern key twice.
test_plans: Pattern fixtures compare identical decoded keys with alternate escape spellings within one scope and valid replacement across base/profile scopes.

rules.requirement: Before lock reads or apply uses a registered generated artifact, the command invokes the same read-only check scoped to exactly those artifacts.
test_plans: Stub-renderer integration tests prove exact-plan drift blocks lock/apply while unrelated output and inactive-theme drift do not.

rules.requirement: A renderer freshness precondition does not generate or modify an artifact.
test_plans: Read-only freshness tests snapshot repository bytes and metadata before and after success, drift, unavailable, unregistered, and indeterminate outcomes.

rules.requirement: After theme apply changes a materialized deployment source, regenerate the lock before reporting a clean repository.
test_plans: Theme-apply integration tests change materialized and linked outputs and assert relock timing, final digest selection, failure propagation, and clean-state reporting.

rules.requirement: A repository-integrated destination command provides the fixed renderer contract or refuses plans containing registered generated artifacts.
test_plans: Destination-plan tests cover present, missing, version-mismatched, unavailable, and incomplete renderer contracts with refusal before mutation.

rules.requirement: A conforming implementation passes all fourteen enumerated fixture suites.
test_plans: Conformance dashboard requires all fourteen fixtures.json families to reach passing status for the applicable language/editor or full-runtime release gate.

rules.requirement: A destination-mutating command satisfies parsing, compilation, freshness, binding, and section 21 safety before any filesystem change.
test_plans: End-to-end mutation tests inject one failure in every prerequisite class and verify an empty mutation journal and unchanged destination filesystem.
